target: Documentary Outline - Episode 3: The Foundry Braid. This episode explores the intersection of Sorensen's Danish origins with his industrial triumph at the Ford Motor Company. Using high-resolution archives of his early emigration logs (Copenhagen 1905) and B-24 engineering diaries (Willow Run 1943), we trace how modular casting concepts traveled across hemispheres. The narrative centers on a resolved metallurgical thread: a single Danish emigrant's foundry gating principles scaling American wartime airpower, cementing Charles Emil Sorensen as the core of industrial modernism.
